Vikram's left hand is bandaged (hidden under a glove in Scene 1).

raw_text:
EPISODE NUMBER: 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: A waitress serving at a billionaire's engagement party discovers the groom is the man who left her for dead five years ago.
CONTINUITY NOTES:
- Maya wears a cracked silver locket in every scene.
- Vikram's left hand is bandaged (hidden under a glove in Scene 1).
- Rain begins at the end of Scene 2 and continues into Episode 2.

SCENE 1: INT. GRAND ASTER HOTEL BALLROOM - NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:00:00 | SCENE END: 00:00:52
CAMERA: Slow dolly through a forest of champagne glasses, landing on MAYA's tired face.
[00:00:00 - 00:00:05] ACTION: Crystal chandeliers blaze. Maya balances a silver tray, eyes down, as a string quartet swells.
[00:00:05 - 00:00:09] MAYA: Table nine. Don't look up. Just get through tonight.
[00:00:09 - 00:00:14] ACTION: A glass shatters nearby. Guests laugh. The head waiter, KUNAL, snaps his fingers at her.
[00:00:14 - 00:00:18] KUNAL: The Malhotras are paying ten lakh for this hour. Smile like you mean it.
[00:00:18 - 00:00:23] ACTION: The lights dim. A spotlight hits the grand staircase. The crowd turns.
[00:00:23 - 00:00:28] ANNOUNCER (V.O.): Ladies and gentlemen, the future of Malhotra Industries — Vikram Malhotra and his bride-to-be, Rhea!
[00:00:28 - 00:00:33] ACTION: Applause. VIKRAM descends, perfect in black, RHEA glittering on his arm.
[00:00:33 - 00:00:38] ACTION: Maya glances up. Freezes. The tray tilts. Her locket catches the light.
[00:00:38 - 00:00:42] MAYA: (whispering) No. No, that's impossible.
[00:00:42 - 00:00:47] ACTION: The tray crashes to the marble floor. Every head turns toward her.
[00:00:47 - 00:00:52] RHEA: Oh dear. Someone get the help out of the way, please.

SCENE 2: INT. GRAND ASTER HOTEL - SERVICE CORRIDOR - NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:00:52 | SCENE END: 00:01:46
CAMERA: Handheld, claustrophobic. Fluorescent light flickers.
[00:00:52 - 00:00:57] ACTION: Maya presses her back to the wall, gasping, clutching the locket.
[00:00:57 - 00:01:02] MAYA: Five years. They told me he died in that fire.
[00:01:02 - 00:01:07] ACTION: Footsteps. Vikram rounds the corner, alone. He stops dead.
[00:01:07 - 00:01:11] VIKRAM: Maya? You... you're alive.
[00:01:11 - 00:01:17] MAYA: You sound disappointed. You locked that door, Vikram. I heard the bolt.
[00:01:17 - 00:01:21] VIKRAM: You don't understand what happened that night.
[00:01:21 - 00:01:26] MAYA: I understand you walked out of the fire. And I didn't.
[00:01:26 - 00:01:31] ACTION: He reaches for her. She slaps him. The sound echoes down the corridor.
[00:01:31 - 00:01:36] ACTION: Rhea appears at the end of the corridor, her smile gone cold.
[00:01:36 - 00:01:41] RHEA: Vikram, darling. Why is the waitress touching my fiancé?
[00:01:41 - 00:01:46] ACTION: Thunder rolls outside. Rain begins to streak the corridor window.

SCENE 3: EXT. GRAND ASTER HOTEL - BACK ALLEY - NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:01:46 | SCENE END: 00:02:34
CAMERA: Wide, rain-soaked, neon reflections in puddles.
[00:01:46 - 00:01:51] ACTION: Maya stumbles into the rain, tearing off her apron.
[00:01:51 - 00:01:56] ACTION: A black car idles. An elderly woman, SAVITRI MALHOTRA, watches from the back seat.
[00:01:56 - 00:02:01] SAVITRI: (to her driver) That locket. Stop the car.
[00:02:01 - 00:02:06] ACTION: Savitri steps out under an umbrella, studying Maya's face.
[00:02:06 - 00:02:11] SAVITRI: Child, where did you get that locket?
[00:02:11 - 00:02:16] MAYA: It's the only thing my mother left me. Why do you care?
[00:02:16 - 00:02:22] ACTION: Savitri opens her own locket. Inside: the same photograph of a young woman.
[00:02:22 - 00:02:28] SAVITRI: Because the woman in that picture was my daughter. Which makes you a Malhotra.
[00:02:28 - 00:02:34] ACTION: Maya stares, rain streaming down her face. Behind them, Vikram watches from the doorway.
